sources.summary: Printout of OPS-ADE action 586011, a modification of the operation notification for data centres, status 'Οριστικά Υποβληθείσα' (finally submitted) on 07/09/2026 16:23, by economic operator Digital Realty Hellas Monoprosopi AE for installation 'DIGITAL REALTY (ATH3) (ΚΡΩΠΙΑΣ)', Ifestou 72-76 'Bota' BIOPA Koropi 19400, Municipality of Kropia, East Attica, with registered latitude 37.87155141033321 and longitude 23.870614305559798. The data centre provides services to third parties; declared total IT equipment power 17,719 kW and main-space area 20,606 m2. Field 18 states that the modification covers all of data centres ATH1, ATH2, ATH3 and ATH4: ATH1 2,053.00 kW IT, ATH2 2,000.00 kW, ATH3 6,863.16 kW and ATH4 6,800.04 kW (total 17,719.20 kW IT; 8,386.57 kW non-IT). Supporting files listed include installer declarations for ATH1-2 and ATH3-4, the PPD environmental decision, existing building-permit documents and a standby-generation production licence.
sources.date_semantics: Action date 07/09/2026 is the filing date of the modified operation notification (used as the status observation). The Region of Attica attached this printout to its post published 2026-09-08 (datePublished 2026-09-08T06:31:55Z; PDF CreationDate 8 September 2026 09:22 EEST), which is the publication date. Capture on 22 October 2026 UTC is retrieval only.
